documentation.description: Only accepts ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD); US and EU formats rejected
documentation.evidence:
Validates a date string. Only accepts ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Example: isValidDate('01/15/2024'); // Returns false (not ISO format)

implementation.description: Accepts ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), US (MM/DD/YYYY), and EU (DD.MM.YYYY) formats
